name: Hinata: A small path to happiness
source:
An optimistic romantic comedy where you follow the struggles of Ito Hinata, a young woman who doesn't look her age.

Will she be able to finally find her place?
And what about happiness?

[From [url=https://azamitsu.itch.io/hinata-a-small-path-to-happiness]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部乐观的浪漫喜剧，讲述了伊藤日向 (Ito Hinata) 的挣扎，一位看起来不像实际年龄的年轻女子。

她最终能找到自己的位置吗？
那么幸福呢？

[来自[url=https://azamitsu.itch.io/hinata-a-small-path-to-happiness]Itch.io[/url]]
